title: Test growing_fixed_base rank1_relex anchor mode (2xH200, rollout_batch)
success_criteria: probe reaches step 24 on 2xH200 with no OOM; peak GPU mem + s/step recorded in `runs/83-growing-fixed-base-anchor/`
probe step-20 per-fire log line reads `history_mode=growing_fixed_base` (code touch effective)
both full arms reach step 100 with no NaN / non-finite grads
growing arm `train.log` shows `history_mode=growing_fixed_base` with per-fire `checkpoints` growing 2→~10; control shows `history_mode=sliding_window` capped at 4

`val-core/DigitalLearningGmbH/MATH-lighteval/{acc|reward}/mean@N` at step 100 (read from the on-box `train.log` capture, not WandB alone — see Notes): growing ≥ control − 1.0 point (primary bar; step 75 corroborates; step 25/50 expected ~identical)
secondary (directional, not a hard gate): growing arm compressed-vs-dense mismatch and per-fire `evr_mean`/`r2_mean` ≤/≥ control (equal-or-better projection quality); `actor/anchor_kl_loss` not worse
post-arm smokes pass: proj-w2-smoke step 24 with fixed-W2 secant fires (checkpoints=2/2); proj-w4-smoke step 44 with step-40 fire showing full W4 fit (checkpoints=4/4); no NaN/OOM
every cell's anchor fires replay the full rollout batch (512 prompts / 4096 seqs)
current-method ladder evidenced in the arms' per-fire lines (W2 secant at 2 checkpoints, full fit at >=4)
hypothesis: With batch_scope=rollout_batch held equal on both arms, growing_fixed_base is non-inferior to the paired sliding_window control on MATH val accuracy at step 100 (within 1.0 absolute point) with no divergence AND equal-or-lower compressed-vs-dense mismatch. Clean negative: growing landing >=1.0 point below control at step 100, or NaN/divergent, or raising mismatch.
